metadata.note: Every action here is a source-verified, runtime-tested, read-only GET call. Each domain is meant to be exposed as ONE MCP tool with an 'action' parameter selecting which underlying GET call to run. Methods that were just SDK-naming duplicates of the same real web address were merged into a single entry.
